newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Payless ShoeSource FY97 up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Payless ShoeSource FY97 up.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Friday it raised its estimate for Payless ShoeSource Inc's earnings in fiscal 1997 to $3.10 from $3.07 based on the company's stronger-than-expected sales trends.

-- Yesterday, Payless also announced it received a favorable tax ruling from the IRS regarding its proposed $150-million share repurchase program. Gruntal said it viewed the ruling as a significant positive development for Payless and it now sees a strong possibility for upside to its estimate for fiscal 1998 of $3.52.
-- Gruntal said it is awaiting further clarification from management before adjusting its 1998 estimate, although current thinking would raise the estimate to $3.63.
-- Its shares closed down 3/8 Friday to 41-1/2.
